mechanism: Isoniazid inhibits CYP1A2 and CYP3A4, potentially increasing duloxetine plasma concentrations and CNS effects; duloxetine may inhibit isoniazid metabolism via CYP3A4.
action: Monitor for increased duloxetine adverse effects (dizziness, sedation, nausea); consider duloxetine dose reduction if CNS symptoms emerge; ensure adequate tuberculosis treatment efficacy.
